ios.desc:
Simmerz is your AI-powered meal planning chef — built for real home cooks who want to eat better without spending hours planning, shopping, or figuring out what's for dinner.

WHAT SIMMERZ DOES
Tell Simmerz your diet type, favorite cuisines, and how many people you're cooking for. It builds a full week of personalized meals, generates a smart grocery list sorted by aisle, and walks you through every recipe step by step.

FREE — NO CREDIT CARD NEEDED
- Calorie count on every recipe
- Up to 5 saved recipes
- Browse the full recipe cookbook
- 3 free Cook Mode sessions with step-by-step timers
- 2 free AI Pantry scans
- 1 free AI Recipe generation

PRO — $4.99/mo
- Unlimited saved recipes
- Smart shopping cart (auto-built from your meal plan)
- Pantry tracking
- Full nutrition & macro tracking (protein, carbs, fat)
- Unlimited Cook Mode

PREMIUM — $9.99/mo
- Everything in Pro
- Unlimited AI Recipe Generator — describe any dish, get a full recipe
- AI Meal Planner — personalized 7-day plans built by AI
- AI Pantry Scanner — point your camera, get recipe suggestions
- Personalized diet filtering (Keto, Vegan, Paleo, and more)

HOW SUBSCRIPTIONS WORK
Simmerz subscriptions are purchased securely on the web via Stripe. After subscribing, sign in to the app with the same email address — your plan unlocks instantly. No App Store billing. Cancel anytime from your Stripe account.

DIET & PREFERENCE SUPPORT
Omnivore, Carnivore, Flexitarian, Vegetarian, Vegan, Pescatarian, Keto, Paleo — Simmerz filters every recipe and meal plan to match your lifestyle perfectly.

COOK MODE
Follow along recipe step by step with built-in timers so nothing burns and nothing gets missed. Works hands-free — just read and cook.

SMART SHOPPING
Your grocery list builds itself from your meal plan, organized by store aisle. Check off items as you shop. No more forgotten ingredients.

AI PANTRY SCANNER
Point your camera at your fridge or pantry. Simmerz identifies what you have and suggests recipes you can make right now — no wasted food.

TERMS OF USE
Simmerz Pro and Premium are auto-renewable monthly subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kreosus.github.io/app-support/privacy.html
